approved: 2026-11-20, Michael (owner), HUMAN_FINAL in chat: "Build it and change A01 so low-risk records auto-accept"
switch: ON and OFF are each a governed AUTO_POLICY_SWITCH record that only a HUMAN_FINAL APPROVE + REG acceptance makes effective. The switch names this file's sha256; a changed file is a new policy and is OFF until switched on again.

classes.rule: source_kind SOURCE_UPLOAD from governed_source_upload; source_sha256 is 64 hex; the preserved descriptor's SHA256, PATH, TITLE and BYTES lines equal the record and the descriptor hash equals the record's source hash; when the file itself is present under UNIFUSION_SOURCES_ROOT its sha256 must match too; no Archonym; CAP exactly OBS; risk L; RECOIL and WVC passed; no facets, Supersedes, build graph, monetization or authority REL keys; no other record shares its source_sha256.

Another record (any state) already carries the same source_sha256 (SOURCE_UPLOAD) or the same preserved source hash, and that record is decided or has the smaller IDN. HOLD only; RESUME is one HUMAN_FINAL press.
Generated provider-combination / trajectory record (REL source_name provider_population). HOLD only, never accepted; RESUME is one HUMAN_FINAL press.

Worker-derived SOURCE_KIN_LINK (topic or kin) whose two distinct ends are both REG-accepted SOURCE_UPLOAD records at decision time; preserved descriptor FROM/TO equal the record; no Archonym; CAP exactly OBS; risk L; RECOIL and WVC passed; no facets, Supersedes or authority REL keys.

never: any record that changes authority (Supersedes, COMPOSITION_KIN, kin_emergion, capability providers, targets, requirements)
wire keys, the GOV gate, the policy itself (AUTO_POLICY_SWITCH)
money or external actions (action authorizations stay HUMAN_FINAL)
worker SOURCE_INSIGHT proposals (summaries, combinations, gaps): they wait AtGOV for one HUMAN_FINAL batch press
undo: REVERT: one HUMAN_FINAL press moves an AUTO_POLICY-accepted record from REG-accepted to HELD (append-only). An AUTO_POLICY HOLD is undone with the existing HUMAN_FINAL RESUME.
